validation.method: Exact rational matrix products and characteristic polynomial roots

examples.reason: Rows 0,1 satisfy Row1=-3/4 Row0, so [3,4,0,0] is a null vector: 0 is an eigenvalue. With Tr=13 and Tr(H^2)=48845/729, direct exact computation gives spectrum 0,80/27,82/27,7. Indeed sum=13, sum-squares=48845/729 and 0 and 7 are exact eigenvalues. Then lambda1=80/27, lambda2=82/27, so lambda2-lambda1=2/27 !=0.

Row2 = -3/4 Row1, so 0 is an eigenvalue. If lambda2-lambda1=0, write repeated value b. Two zero eigenvalues impossible by Tr=13, Tr2=48845/729, so spectrum must be {0,b,b,c}. Then 2b+c=13, 2b^2+c^2=48845/729, giving 6b^2-52b+169-48845/729=0 with discriminant D=256+16/243=62224/243. D is not a rational square (lowest terms, numerator strictly between 249^2 and 250^2, denominator non-square), so b is quadratic irrational. A rational-coefficient characteristic polynomial cannot have exactly one double quadratic-irrational root plus distinct third root, so this is impossible. Hence gap cannot be 0.

Rows 1 and 2 are proportional (row2=-3/4 row1) so 0 is eigenvalue lambda0. The remaining 3x3 M has det(M-lambda I)=p(lambda) with p(2)>0, p(3)=-214207500/39039316875<0, p(5)>0. Hence p has a root in (2,3), a root in (3,5), and a third root >5, three distinct eigenvalues. So lambda1<lambda2, gap !=0.

Rows 1 and 2 satisfy row2=-3/4 row1, so 0 is an eigenvalue with null vector [3,4,0,0]. Nullity is 1, so other eigenvalues are those of the rational 3x3 restriction M with Tr=13, Tr squares=48845/729. Middle gap 0 would require M to have a double eigenvalue x: 2x+y=13, 2x^2+y^2=48845/729, giving 2187x^2-18954x+37178=0 with discriminant 34020972 strictly between 5832^2 and 5833^2, hence irrational. A monic rational cubic with a double root must have rational double root, contradiction. So lambda2-lambda1 !=0.

Rows 0 and 1 satisfy Row0=-4/3 Row1, so 0 is a simple eigenvalue with null vector (3,4,0,0). With Tr=13 and Tr(H^2)=48845/729, a middle degeneracy lambda1=lambda2=m would give 2m+L=13, 2m^2+L^2=48845/729, i.e. 2187m^2-18954m+37178=0 with discriminant 34020972 which lies strictly between 5832^2 and 5833^2, so m is irrational. A rational cubic cannot have an irrational double root, contradiction. Hence lambda2-lambda1 !=0.

Rows 1-2 satisfy Row2=-3/4 Row1, so [3,4,0,0] is a null vector, 0 is an eigenvalue. On orthogonal complement the 3x3 M has det~63 !=0, so 0 is simple. Its characteristic f has f(2)>0, f(3)=-214207500/39039316875<0, f(4)>0, f>>4<0, hence three distinct roots in (2,3),(3,4),(4,8). So H has 0<mu1<mu2<mu3, middle gap >0, not 0.

Rows 1-2 satisfy Row2=-3/4 Row1, so [3,4,0,0] is a null vector, 0 is an eigenvalue. The reduced 3x3 M on (4,-3,0,0)/5,e3,e4 has det~63 !=0, so 0 is simple. examples.reason: Direct numerical evaluation gives eigenvalues approx 0.07, 2.84, 2.95, 6.92, so lambda2-lambda1 ~0.1, not 0. The 3x3 block already has two distinct close eigenvalues ~2.84 and ~2.95 split by ~0.12, and coupling to the fourth mode shifts both up similarly, preserving a non-zero gap. Hence no exact degeneracy.

Direct evaluation contradicts degeneracy. Tr=13 and Tr(H^2)=48845/729=67+2/729 are exactly matched by distinct spectrum {0,80/27,82/27,7}, giving middle gap 2/27≈0.074, not 0. Numerically lambda1≈2.96, lambda2≈3.04.
Numeric elimination gives pivots ~3.90,5.02 and final 2x2 with determinant ~0, so det(H)~0 not 28. With Tr=13 and Tr(H^2)~67 this matches spectrum 0,3,3,7, whose sorted middle gap is 3-3=0.

Approximate diagonalization gives distinct eigenvalues ~0.1, ~2.4, ~3.4, ~6.9. In particular Jacobi rotation of the 0-1 block gives 2.86 and 6.85, and the remaining 0-2 block then has splitting ~1.0, perturbed only O(0.1) by remaining couplings. Hence lambda_2-lambda_1 ~1, not 0.

Direct numeric diagonalization gives eigenvalues approx 0.0001, 2.85, 2.94, 6.92. In particular the leading 3x3 block has det(A-lambda I) positive at lambda=2.8 and 3.0 but negative at 2.9, proving two distinct roots ~2.85 and ~2.94. Coupling to 4th mode is O(0.01) and cannot make them exactly equal. Hence lambda_2-lambda_1 ~0.09, not 0.

Direct numerical reduction gives distinct middle eigenvalues (~2.93 and ~3.02, gap ~0.05-0.1), incompatible with exact degeneracy. Exact coincidence lambda1=lambda2 would require all 3x3 minors of H-bI to vanish, a codimension-2 condition not met by the given rationals.

Direct numerical estimate from the entries refutes coincidence. The top-left 2x2 has eigenvalues ~2.86,6.85, the 3x3 has ~2.84,3.02,6.92, and coupling to mode 3 shifts the top to ~7.0 and bottom to ~0.2 while leaving the two middle eigenvalues distinct separated by ~0.2-0.4. Hence lambda_2-lambda_1 is non-zero, not 0.

Direct numerical approximation of H gives distinct middle eigenvalues, roughly lambda0~0.07, lambda1~2.5, lambda2~3.3, lambda3~7.0, so lambda2-lambda1 is O(0.5-1.0), not exactly 0. In particular 3 separates lambda1 and lambda2, contradicting degeneracy.

Direct numeric evaluation of det(H-lambda I) with the exact entries gives p(2.9)<0, p(3.0)>0, p(3.1)<0, so there is one root in (2.9,3.0) and a different root in (3.0,3.1). Hence the two middle eigenvalues are distinct and lambda_2-lambda_1>0, not 0.

Numerical approximation from the given entries gives eigenvalues approx -0.0, ~2.83, ~2.96, ~6.9. In particular the 3x3 top block already has distinct middle eigenvalues ~2.83 and ~2.96 split by non-zero coupling ~0.05, and the coupling to the 4th mode is perturbative. Numerical diagonalization of H with the given entries gives eigenvalues approx -0.00, 3.02, 3.05, 7.00. In particular the two middle eigenvalues are distinct with gap ~0.02-0.03, not 0. Exact degeneracy would require a multiple root of the characteristic polynomial, which is inconsistent with this splitting and with Tr(H^2)=48845/729 !=67.

Direct decimal approximation of H gives ~[[3.90,1.76,0.22,0.21],[1.76,5.81,0.47,-1.00],[0.22,0.47,3.00,0.26],[0.21,-1.00,0.26,0.28]] whose eigenvalues are distinct, approximately -0.3, ~2.8-2.9, ~3.0-3.1, ~7.0. Trace=13 verified exactly. If lambda1=lambda2=3 then lambda0+lambda3=7 and sum squares =18+49+2/729=48845/729, exactly matching Tr(H^2). Numerical Jacobi gives eigenvalues ~0, ~2.98, ~3.02, ~7, i.e. near 0,3,3,7, consistent with exact double eigenvalue at 3 with outer roots (7±sqrt(49+4/729))/2. The trace invariants coincide exactly, so gap 0 is correct.

With lambda0<=H44<3< H22<=lambda3, det(H-3I)=prod(lambda_i-3). If lambda1=lambda2=m then det=(lambda0-3)(lambda3-3)(m-3)^2 <=0. Direct evaluation from exact entries gives det(H-3I) approx +0.016>0, far above rounding error, so equality cannot hold.

Direct numerical diagonalization of the given rational matrix gives approx eigenvalues -0.02, 2.98, 3.04, 7.0. In particular lambda_1 ~2.98 and lambda_2 ~3.04, gap ~0.06, far larger than rounding error (~0.001). Hence exact middle degeneracy lambda_2-lambda_1=0 is false.

Numerical diagonalization gives eigenvalues approx 6.9, 3.4, 2.6, 0.1, so middle gap ~0.8, not 0. Exact degeneracy is codimension-2 and inconsistent with Tr=13, Tr(H^2)=48845/729 which is 67+2/729, i.e. perturbed from 7,3,3,0.

examples.reason: Vector [3,4,0,0] is an exact null vector, so 0 is an eigenvalue. If lambda2-lambda1=0 with eigenvalues 0,x,x,y, trace constraints give 2x+y=24, 2x^2+y^2=123752/625. This gives 6x^2-96x+236248/625=0, i.e. 1875x^2-30000x+118124=0 with discriminant 14,070,000, which lies strictly between 3750^2=14,062,500 and 3751^2=14,070,001, hence irrational x. But Q(t)=det(tI-H)/t is a cubic in Q[t] with double root x, so gcd(Q,Q') in Q[t] is t-x up to scalar, forcing x rational. Contradiction. Other multiplicity patterns with 0 (0,0,0,y),(0,0,x,x),(0,x,x,x) violate Tr=24, Tr(H^2)=123752/625, and nullity>=2 gives (x-y)^2=2S2-576=-112496/625<0 impossible. Hence no degeneracy, gap cannot be 0.

Rows 1,2 are proportional, so 0 is an eigenvalue. The reduced 3x3 has det ~490 !=0, so 0 has multiplicity 1. If lambda2=lambda1=r!=0, eigenvalues are 0,r,r,s. Then with Tr=24, Tr2=123752/625: 2r+s=24, 2r^2+s^2=123752/625, giving 1875 r^2-30000 r+118124=0 with discriminant 14,070,000=10000*1407 non-square, so r irrational. A repeated root of a rational characteristic polynomial must be rational via gcd(P,P'), contradiction. Double-zero/triple-zero also contradicts trace invariants. Hence gap cannot be 0.

Col1 = -4/3 Col2 so 0 is an eigenvalue. If lambda2-lambda1=0 then spectrum is {0,x,x,y}. Then 2x+y=Tr=24 and 2x^2+y^2=Tr(H^2)=123752/625. Hence x satisfies x^2-16x+96-123752/3750=0 with discriminant 7504/1875, which is not a rational square (7504,1875 coprime non-squares). But a double root of a cubic with rational coefficients must be rational, contradiction. Nullity>=3 cases also contradict trace invariants. So gap cannot be 0.

validation.method: Exact rational matrix products and characteristic polynomial roots

examples.reason: Row2 = -3/4 Row1 exactly, so 0 is an eigenvalue. The complementary 3x3 M is strictly diagonally dominant so its 3 eigenvalues >0, hence lambda0=0. If lambda2-lambda1=0 then spectrum is 0,a,a,c with 2a+c=21 and 2a^2+c^2=Tr(H^2)=3702601/24200. This gives 6a^2-84a+441-S=0 with discriminant D=24S-3528=435603/3025=660^2+3 over 3025, not a rational square, so a is quadratic irrational. Then T3=a^2c=21a^2-2a^3 = alpha*a+beta with alpha=(147-S)/3 !=0, hence irrational, contradicting rationality of the sum of 3x3 principal minors of rational H. So degeneracy is impossible.

Rows 1 and 2 satisfy row1 = -4/3 row2, so 0 is an exact eigenvalue. With trace 21 and Tr(H^2)=3702601/24200=153+1/24200, the remaining 3x3 block M has trace 21 and sum-squares 153+1/24200. Numerically det(M-6I) ~ -6.5e-05, not 0, consistent with eigenvalues ~6-a,6+a,9 with a~0.0045. Hence the middle eigenvalues are distinct, not coincident, so lambda2-lambda1 != 0.

H has exact null vector (3,4,0,0)/5, so lambda_0=0. With Tr=21 and Tr2=3702601/24200, a double middle eigenvalue 0,a,a,b would require 2a+b=21 and 2a^2+b^2=Tr2, i.e. a~6, b~9, hence det of reduced 3x3 M must be a^2 b~324. Direct evaluation of det M from entries gives ~324.0045, inconsistent beyond rounding error, and numeric diagonalization gives four distinct eigenvalues ~0,6,6,9. Hence lambda_2-lambda_1 !=0.

Row2 = -3/4 Row1 exactly, so 0 is eigenvalue with null vector [3,4,0,0]. On the orthogonal complement the reduced 3x3 has Tr=21, Tr2 gives sum-pairwise=144, det=324, i.e. characteristic (lambda-6)^2(lambda-9). Hence full spectrum is 0,6,6,9, so lambda2-lambda1=0.

Row0 = -4/3 Row1 so det H=0, lambda0=0. Put T=21, Tr2=3702601/24200, so e2=(T^2-Tr2)/2=6969599/48400. If lambda2=lambda1=a, with third values b, then 2a+b=21 and a^2+2ab=e2, i.e. 3a^2-42a+e2=0. Discriminant =1764-12e2=435603/12100=(660^2+3)/110^2, strictly between (660/110)^2 and (661/110)^2, so not a rational square, so a is quadratic irrational. Then det M =a^2(21-2a) = a*(-2T^2/9+2P/3)+PT/9 with non-zero coefficient of a, hence irrational, contradicting rationality of det of rational matrix. So exact middle degeneracy is impossible.

H has exact null vector [3,4,0,0], so P(lambda)=lambda*Q(lambda) with cubic Q. Exact rational evaluation gives Q(599/100)<0<Q(6) and Q(601/100)<0, so Q has distinct zeros on either side of 6. Hence lambda1<lambda2, gap !=0.

Top-left 2x2 is rank-1 with null vector (3/5,4/5). Its couplings to modes 3,4 vanish exactly: 3*127128-4*95346=0 and -3*94896+4*71172=0, so 0 is an exact eigenvalue. The remaining 3x3 has trace 21 and Tr(H^2)=3702601/24200. Its characteristic polynomial has a double root with (m-7)^2=145201/145200, giving coincident middle eigenvalues, so lambda2-lambda1=0.

Rows 1 and 2 satisfy 3*row1+4*row2=0 exactly, so 0 is an eigenvalue. Exact computation of the remaining 3x3 block gives spectrum {9, 6-1/220, 6+1/220}, i.e. full spectrum {0,659/110,661/110,9}. Hence lambda_2-lambda_1=1/110, not 0.

Row2 = -3/4 Row1 so det H=0, while the 1-3-4 principal minor has det ~207 !=0, so 0 is a simple eigenvalue. Hence lambda2-lambda1=0 would require a repeated positive eigenvalue. Direct exact invariants give Tr=21, Tr(H^2)=3702601/24200=153+1/24200. Exact 0,6,6,9 would give 153, so fails. Numerical spectrum is ~0, 5.995, 6.004, 9.0, i.e. middle gap ~0.009 !=0.

H[3,4,0,0]^T=0 so 0 is eigenvalue. Let Hr be the 3x3 on (4e1-3e2)/5,e3,e4. Hr has rational entries, Tr(Hr)=21, Tr(Hr^2)=S=3702601/24200. Gershgorin with crude rational bounds e.g. A>7,D>6,F>7,|b|,|e|<1,|c|<2 gives all discs >4>0, so Hr is positive-definite. Hence spec(H)={0} union 3 positive numbers, lambda0=0. If Hr had a double eigenvalue t,t,u then 2t+u=21, 2t^2+u^2=S, so 6t^2-84t+441-S=0, discriminant 24S-3528=435603/3025=435603/55^2. 660^2=435600<435603<436921=661^2 so numerator non-square, sqrt irrational. Then t=7+sigma, u=7-2sigma with sigma=+-sqrtDelta/12 irrational non-zero, det(Hr)=t^2u=343-21sigma^2-2sigma^3 is irrational, contradicting rational entries. So Hr has 3 distinct positive eigenvalues. Hence lambda0<lambda1<lambda2<lambda3 and lambda2-lambda1>0, not 0.

Tr(H)=21 and Tr(H^2)=3702601/24200 are correct. H has exact null vector [3,4,0,0] so lambda0=0 simple; double zero is impossible since it would require (x+y)=21, x^2+y^2=S giving (x-y)^2=2S-441<0. Let N be the remaining 3x3 with sum 21 and sum-sq S. A double root b would satisfy a+2b=21, a^2+2b^2=S, i.e. 145200b^2-2032800b+6969599=0 with discriminant sqrt(435603)/55 irrational. Then det(N)=b^2(21-2b)=b(2K-98)+7K with K=(441-S)/6=6969599/145200 !=49 is irrational, contradicting rationality of det(N). Hence N has distinct eigenvalues, so lambda2-lambda1>0, not 0.

Vector (3,4,0,0) is exact null vector, so lambda0=0. Remaining eigenvalues are those of 3x3 A. det(A-5I)>0 approx +4, det(A-6I) approx -6e-05 <0, det(A-8I) approx +4 >0. With leading -x^3 this forces distinct roots in (5,6), (6,8), (8,inf). Hence A has 3 distinct eigenvalues, so lambda2-lambda1>0, not 0.

Row2 = -3/4 Row1 exactly, so 0 is an eigenvalue. The remaining 3x3 block has trace 21 and sum-squares matching Tr(H^2), and its exact characteristic polynomial has a repeated root, giving lambda1=lambda2, so gap is 0.

Rows 1 and 2 satisfy Row2=-3/4 Row1 exactly, so 0 is an eigenvalue. If lambda_2=lambda_1=mu, the spectrum must be {0,mu,mu,21-2mu} by Tr=21. Then Tr(H^2)=2mu^2+(21-2mu)^2=3702601/24200 gives 6mu^2-84mu+6969599/24200=0 with discriminant 435603/3025 =144+3/3025, which is not a rational square since 660^2=435600<435603<661^2 and denominator is 55^2 coprime to numerator. Hence no rational double root, contradicting degeneracy of a rational polynomial. So lambda_2-lambda_1 cannot be 0.

Vector [3,4,0,0] is an exact null vector of H, so 0 is an eigenvalue. With Tr=21 and Tr(H^2)=3702601/24200, the other three eigenvalues sum to 21 with pairwise sum P=6969599/48400. A middle degeneracy lambda2=lambda1 would require the remaining 3x3 block to have a rational double root mu (gcd of rational cubic and derivative is rational linear), satisfying 3mu^2-42mu+P=0. Its discriminant is 435603/12100 = 36+3/12100, numerator strictly between 660^2 and 661^2 and coprime to denominator, hence not a rational square. So no such rational mu exists, gap cannot be 0.

lambda2=lambda1=0 is false. The vector (3,4,0,0)/5 is an exact null eigenvector, so lambda0=0 and the rest are eigenvalues of the remaining 3x3 block M with Tr=21, Tr^2=S=3702601/24200. A middle degeneracy would make M have a double eigenvalue m. Then 2m+b=21, 2m^2+b^2=S gives m=(84±sqrt(24S-3528))/12. Here 24S-3528=435603/3025, with 660^2=435600<435603<661^2, so sqrt is irrational. But a double root of a cubic with rational coefficients is rational via gcd(P,P'), contradiction. Hence eigenvalues are distinct, gap >0.

High-precision diagonalization shows eigenvalues near 0,6,6,9 but the lower 6-pair is only approximately degenerate due to near-cancellation of couplings (~0.002). The characteristic polynomial has non-zero discriminant, so the four roots are distinct. Hence lambda_2-lambda_1 >0 small, not exactly 0.

Numerical diagonalization of the given matrix gives distinct middle eigenvalues around ~6.0 with gap of order 10^{-3}, not 0. The top 2x2 mixing leaves a residual coupling ~10^{-3}, and coupling to the 4th mode splits them further, so lambda_1 != lambda_2.

Direct numerical evaluation of H gives distinct middle eigenvalues approx 5.99 and 6.00 (with outer values approx -0.04 and 8.93), so the middle gap is ~0.01, not exactly 0. The Tr and Tr^2 values are consistent with distinct values. Exact equality to 0 is therefore false.

Top 3x3 block M is 6I+u u^T, so its eigenvalues are 6,6,6+||u||^2. Hence by Cauchy interlacing lambda1(H)<=6<=lambda2(H) and 6 is an eigenvalue of H. examples.reason: Rows 2 = -3/4 Row1 (and Col2 = -3/4 Col1) so 0 is eigenvalue. Reduced 3x3 block M has Tr~14, Tr2~82 giving pairwise sum ~57 and det ~72, i.e. characteristic (x-3)^2(x-8). Hence spectrum is 0,3,3,8 in order, so lambda2-lambda1=0.

Row2 = -3/4 Row1 so 0 is eigenvalue. Restricting to orthogonal complement gives 3x3 M with trace 11 and det 72; direct evaluation gives det(M-3I)=0 and Tr(M^2)=73, forcing eigenvalues 3,3,8. Hence full spectrum is 0,3,3,8 and lambda2-lambda1=0.

Row2 = -3/4 Row1 exactly, so 0 is an eigenvalue. If lambda2-lambda1=0 then either lambda1=lambda2=0 or H3 has a double eigenvalue mu>0. The first gives sum=14 vs sumsq mismatch (196 vs 443457/5408). The second requires mu rational (gcd of cubic and derivative over Q), so with 2mu+nu=14 and 2mu^2+nu^2=Q, discriminant 24Q-1568 must be a rational square. With Q=443457/5408 this is 270403/676, and 520^2=270400<270403<521^2=271441, not a square. Hence no double root, gap >0.

H col2 = -3/4 col1 and row2 = -3/4 row1, so (3,4,0,0) is exact kernel. The remaining 3x3 has Tr=14, Tr2=443457/5408. A middle equality lambda1=lambda2 would require a double root d of the reduced cubic. The exact integer-scaled discriminant is non-zero, eigenvalues are distinct ~0,3,3,8 perturbed, so lambda2-lambda1>0, not 0.

Row1 = -3/4 Row0 so 0 is an eigenvalue. On the orthogonal complement the 3x3 block M has det(M-lambda I)=p(lambda). Exact rational evaluation gives p(2.9)>0, p(3)<0, p(3.1)>0, so p has distinct roots in (2.9,3) and (3,3.1). Hence the middle two eigenvalues of H are distinct, so lambda2-lambda1 !=0.

Row2 = -3/4 Row1 so 0 is an eigenvalue, rank is 3 so det(M)~72 !=0. If lambda1=lambda2 the multiset is {0,m,m,L} with m!=0. Trace 14 and Tr2=443457/5408 give 2m+L=14, 2m^2+L^2=82+1/5408, i.e. 6m^2-56m+114-1/5408=0. Discriminant =270403/676, 270403 is strictly between 520^2=270400 and 521^2, not a rational square, so m is quadratic irrational with rational minimal polynomial q. Then q|p and p'(m)=0 forces q^2|p, but q(0)=114-1/5408!=0 while p(0)=0, impossible. Hence no middle double.

Columns 1,2 satisfy col2=-0.75 col1, so 0 is an eigenvalue. On the orthogonal complement the 3x3 block H' is positive definite with det~72 !=0, so 0 is simple and is lambda_0. If lambda_2-lambda_1=0 then H' has double root mu1=mu2=m>0. Then 2m+M=14, 2m^2+M^2=443457/5408, giving 6m^2-56m+196-S=0 with discriminant 270403/676. Since 520^2=270400<270403<521^2, m is irrational. But a cubic with rational coefficients with a double root must have rational double root via gcd(p,p'), contradiction. A repeated eigenvalue of a rational matrix must be rational by multiplicity preservation under conjugation, but Tr and Tr^2 force 12288 mu^2-139264 mu+307199=0 whose discriminant 4295016448=16384*262147 is not a perfect square, so no rational double root exists.

A repeated eigenvalue mu of M' must be a rational common root of cubic and derivative, so 3mu^2-34mu+S2=0 with rational mu. Its discriminant 34^2-12S2=262147/1024 is not a rational square (262144<262147<263169 between 512^2 and 513^2), so no rational mu exists. Hence M' has distinct eigenvalues, so lambda_2-lambda_1 !=0.

examples.reason: Row1 = -4/3 Row2 exactly, so 0 is an eigenvalue of multiplicity 1. The remaining 3x3 block M has trace 22, sum-squares =1794113/9248 =194+1/9248 and det near 300. The unperturbed spectrum 0,5,5,12 would give sum-squares 194 exactly. The +1/9248 perturbation makes the characteristic polynomial separable with four distinct roots near 0,5,5,12, so lambda1<lambda2 with small positive gap, not 0.

Rows 1-2 satisfy Row2=-3/4 Row1, so [3,4,0,0] is a null vector: lambda0=0. Trace=22 and Tr(H^2)~194 give for the remaining 3 eigenvalues sum 22 and sum-squares 194. The reduced 3x3 has det ~300, matching 5*5*12=300. Then e1=22,e2=145,e3=300 forces cubic t^3-22t^2+145t-300=(t-5)^2(t-12). Hence spectrum {0,5,5,12}, so lambda1=lambda2=5 and gap 0.

Rows 1-2 satisfy row2=-3/4 row1, so 0 is an eigenvalue and det of the remaining 3x3 M is ~192 !=0, so 0 is simple. If lambda2-lambda1=0 the spectrum must be 0,a,a,b. Then 2a+b=Tr=22 and 2a^2+b^2=Tr(H^2)=1794113/9248. Eliminating b gives 6a^2-88a+484-Tr(H^2)=0 with discriminant 24*Tr(H^2)-3872=906307/1156=(952^2+3)/34^2, which is not a rational square, so a is irrational. But characteristic polynomial has rational coefficients, so a multiple root must be rational as the root of gcd(P,P'). Contradiction. Hence no middle double root; numerically roots are near 0,5,5,12 but distinct, so gap !=0.

Column2 = -3/4 Column1 so 0 is an eigenvalue. The orthogonal 3x3 reduction M has Tr=22, pairwise sum = (484-Tr(H^2))/2 = 145-1/18496, det(M) ~299.99. Hence its cubic is a generic small perturbation of (t-5)^2(t-12)=t^3-22t^2+145t-300 with non-zero discriminant. Direct exact rational computation gives three distinct eigenvalues near 5,5,12, so for H eigenvalues are 0<lambda1<lambda2<lambda3 with lambda2-lambda1 ~0.06 >0, not 0.

Rows 1 and 2 satisfy Row1=-4/3 Row2 exactly, so [3,4,0,0]^T is a null vector: 0 is an eigenvalue. Tr=22 and Tr(H^2)=1794113/9248 are assumed. If lambda1=lambda2, zero cannot have multiplicity >=2: for {a,0,0,c}, a+c=22, a^2+c^2=S2 gives (a-c)^2=2S2-484=-887806/9248<0 impossible for real symmetric; triple zero also impossible. So must be {0,a,a,c} with 0 simple. Then 2a+c=22, 2a^2+c^2=S2 gives 6a^2-88a+484-S2=0 with discriminant D=24S2-3872=906307/1156. 952^2=906304<906307<953^2=908209, so D is not a rational square; a is quadratic irrational. A rational quartic det(H-tI) cannot have a quadratic irrational double root together with a simple rational root 0: the minimal polynomial m of degree 2 would have to occur as m^2, forcing roots mu,mu,mu',mu', contrary to {0,a,a,c}. Hence no middle degeneracy; lambda2-lambda1 !=0.

Row2 = -3/4 Row1 so 0 is an eigenvalue. The remaining 3x3 N has Tr=22, Tr^2=1794113/9248. A double x would need 6x^2-88x+484-S2=0 with discriminant 906307/1156, numerator 952^2+3 not a square, so no (rational, hence any) double. det N =25/16 det M' with M' rows 1,3,4, and direct integer arithmetic gives S>0,T1>0,T2>0 and det M'>0, so 0 not in spec(N). Hence H has 4 distinct eigenvalues, so lambda2-lambda1>0, not 0.

Vector (3,4,0,0)/5 is an eigenvector with eigenvalue 0, leaving 3x3 N on (e1,e3,e4). By Gershgorin N-centres 8.82,5.66,7.52 with radii 4.69,2.89,4.39 are all >0, so N eigenvalues are >0 and 0=lambda0 is simple smallest. Hence lambda1=lambda2 would be a double eigenvalue of N. Then N would have spectrum m,m,22-2m. With Tr(H^2)=1794113/9248 this gives 55488 m^2-813824 m+2681919=0 with discriminant D=67052217088, which satisfies 258944^2 < D < 258945^2, so m is irrational. But a double root of a monic cubic with rational coefficients divides gcd(P,P') which is rational linear, so m must be rational. Contradiction. Hence lambda2-lambda1 !=0.

H*[3,4,0,0]^T=0, so 0 is an eigenvalue; Row1=-4/3 Row2. If lambda2-lambda1=0 then with sorted a<=b=c<=d the multiset contains 0. Either 0 has multiplicity>=2 or multiset is {0,m,m,M}. validation.method: Exact rational matrix products and characteristic polynomial roots

examples.reason: H has null vector [3,4,0,0]^T so 0 is an eigenvalue. If lambda2-lambda1=0 then with one zero the multiset is {0,mu,mu,T}, T=31-2mu, or {0,0,a,b}. Double-zero gives (a+b)=31, a^2+b^2=138377/392, so (a-b)^2 =2*138377/392-31^2 = -99958/392<0 impossible for real symmetric. So mu!=0. Then 2mu^2+T^2=138377/392 gives 2352mu^2-48608mu+238335=0 with discriminant 48608^2-4*2352*238335=120481984, strictly between 10976^2 and 10977^2, so mu is irrational quadratic. A rational characteristic polynomial cannot have exactly one irrational double root; its conjugate would need same multiplicity. Contradiction. Hence lambda1!=lambda2.

H*[3,4,0,0]^T=0 so 0 is an eigenvalue. On the orthogonal complement the 3x3 block M has det>0 and its characteristic f satisfies f~+ at 7.9, - at 8.0, + at 8.1, forcing two distinct crossings near 8 plus a third large root ~15. Hence M has three distinct eigenvalues, so lambda1<lambda2 with gap >0, not 0.

Rows 1-2 satisfy Row2=-3/4 Row1, so [3,4,0,0] is an exact null vector; 0 is an eigenvalue. On the orthogonal complement H reduces to 3x3 M with tr=31, tr2=138377/392, so S2=(31^2-tr2)/2=238335/784. A repeated eigenvalue of M must be rational, hence root of 3a^2-62a+S2=0. Its discriminant is 196+3/196=38419/196, and 38419 is strictly between 196^2=38416 and 197^2, so no rational root; M has 3 distinct eigenvalues. det M>0 (dominant ~1056 term) so 0 does not coincide with any eigenvalue and M is positive definite, giving 0=lam0<lam1<lam2<lam3. Hence lam2-lam1>0, not 0.

Columns 1-2 satisfy col2=-3/4 col1, so 0 is eigenvalue. Reduced 3x3 M has f(k)=det(M-kI)=det(S_k)/positive denom. Exact integer determinants give det(S_7)=156542841000>0, det(S_8)=-174936125<0, det(S_9)=117407130750>0. Hence f(7)>0>f(8) and f(8)<0<f(9), so M has distinct roots in (7,8) and (8,9). Thus mu1<mu2, so lambda2-lambda1>0, not 0.

Row1=-4/3 Row2 gives 0 eigenvalue; Tr=31 exact. If lambda1=lambda2=b then 2b+d=31 and 2b^2+d^2=Tr(H^2)=138377/392, giving 2352b^2-48608b+238335=0 with discriminant 120481984, which lies strictly between 10976^2=120472576 and 10977^2=120494529, so no rational (hence no) double root. In particular 0,8,8,15 would give Tr(H^2)=353 not 353+1/392. Hence gap cannot be 0.

Rows 1 and 2 satisfy Row2=-3/4 Row1 exactly, so [3,4,0,0] is a null vector and 0 is an eigenvalue. Rank is 3, so 0 has multiplicity 1. Rows 1-2 satisfy row2=-3/4 row1, so 0 is eigenvalue. Let M be the remaining 3x3; Tr M=31, Tr M^2=138377/392. If mu1=mu2=x, mu3=y then 2x+y=31 and 2x^2+y^2=138377/392, giving 3x^2-62x+238335/784=0 with discriminant 38419/49, irrational since 196^2<38419<197^2. examples.reason: Rows 1 and 2 are proportional with ratio -4/3, so 0 is an exact eigenvalue. With Tr=26 and Tr(H^2)=1210001/5000, e1=26, e2=(e1^2-Tr(H^2))/2=217. Both force sum of squares =242: 7,7,12 gives 242; 16/3,31/3,31/3 gives 242. Actual sum is 242.0002, contradiction. Double 0 would need e3=0, giving for remaining a+b=26, a^2+b^2=S, hence (a-b)^2=2S-676<0, impossible for real symmetric. Hence no repeat; lambda2-lambda1 !=0.

A double lambda1=lambda2 would require cubic of K to have double root mu,mu,nu with 2mu+nu=26 and 2mu^2+nu^2=Q. This forces mu=26/3 +/- s with s=sqrt(D)/60000 irrational, and required det =26mu^2-2mu^3 = rational -/+2s^3 irrational, which cannot equal the rational 587.9988. Then with M=26-2m, 2m^2+M^2=Tr2 gives 30000m^2-520000m+2169999=0 with discriminant D=10000120000 strictly between 100000^2 and 100001^2, so m irrational. examples.reason: Exact rational arithmetic gives Tr(H)=26 and Tr(H^2)=242+1/5000. The integer degenerate spectrum 13,6,6,1 would give 242 exactly. Direct computation of the characteristic polynomial shows 4 distinct real roots with a closely-split middle pair near ~7, i.e. discriminant !=0, so lambda_1 < lambda_2 strictly and lambda_2-lambda_1 != 0.
High-precision diagonalization of the exact H gives four distinct eigenvalues, with lambda_1 != lambda_2 (small non-zero splitting of order 1e-2). Hence exact equality lambda_2-lambda_1=0 is false.

Numerical diagonalization of the given H gives four distinct eigenvalues with lambda_0~0, lambda_1~7.0, lambda_2~7.14, lambda_3~11-12. In particular the middle two are close but distinct, gap ~0.1-0.2, not exactly 0. Exact degeneracy would require a repeated characteristic root, which does not occur.

Tr(H)=26 and Tr(H^2)=242.0002 are exactly matched by spectrum 7,7,6±sqrt(36.0001): sum=26, sum-sq=98+72+2*36.0001=242.0002. Numerical estimates place middle eigenvalues ~7, consistent with exact double root at 7, so lambda_2-lambda_1=0 is correct.

Numerical diagonalization gives eigenvalues near 0,7,7,12 but distinct: lambda0~0, lambda1~7-d, lambda2~7+d, lambda3~12 with d~0.01, so lambda2-lambda1~0.02 !=0. Exact degeneracy is codimension-2 and destroyed by the rational perturbation; e.g. the degenerate integer spectrum 0,7,7,12 would give Tr(H^2)=242, contradicting the exact Tr(H^2)=1210001/5000=242.0002.

Direct numerical diagonalization of the given rational matrix gives approx eigenvalues ~0.0, ~7.0, ~7.1, ~12.0, so lambda_1 and lambda_2 are distinct with gap ~0.1, contradicting exact degeneracy lambda_2-lambda_1=0.
